7S130 is a six system solid state distance protection has three of them use star measuring quantities and the other use delta measuring quantities.
The six assuring systems could set for distance independent of each other. The operating time is half cycle.

Independent is setting of reach along the resistance and reactance.
Has quadrilateral characteristic for tripping.
